title: ModuleTaskDependencyBaseAdapter
responsibility: Compose accepted dependency checkpoints into an isolated parent task source revision.

inputs.name: resolve.input
inputs.description: Only accepted checkpoint revisions supplied by the trusted worker, each descending from source.

outputs.name: resolve
outputs.description: Returns source for zero, checkpoint for one, or a deterministic immutable merge commit containing all compatible checkpoints. Uses a private Git index, validates/adopts committed metadata, and protects generated commits with a Harness-owned ref; never mutates user branches, worktree or index. Uses a private Git index and deterministic commit identity/date, validates commit ancestry and metadata, and protects each generated merge under refs/harness/task-bases/<commit>.

errors.name: invalid, unrelated, conflicting or inadmissible checkpoint
errors.description: Reject without mutating user state or creating a successful protected ref; clean owned temp index.
